SHARD AXE
SHARD SERIES
The '''Shard Axe''', formerly '''Amethyst Axe,''' is a shard tool that '''breaks the entire tree including leaves''' upon a log being chopped. It's a useful utility item for players who need to obtain large amounts of wood or clear out some terrain, as its insta-mines any tree. As any shard tool, '''this item has a self destruction timer of 1 day (formerly 3).''' Players tend to auction flip gear like this. This item used to be '''obtained with the now removed [[Amethyst Crate]]''', and can be obtained from [[Auction House]] or buying from the shard shop for 3k shards.
